title: ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer coverage — GRC 101
intro: GRC 101 is an intern-level programme. The alignment below means a GRC 101 graduate has practised every Lead Implementer competency on the synthetic BKB organisations and can sit a Lead Implementer course and exam with a strong foundation. It does not award, replace or guarantee any certification. The PECB "Lead Implementer" credential additionally requires 5 years of professional experience (2 in information security management) and 300 hours of ISMS project activity; "Provisional Implementer" requires the exam only. Statements are summarised from the PECB handbook; ISO text is not reproduced. Under the Guided Execution Model, "Applied" means the mentee produced the implementer's artefact by following the given rules (L01–L25); independent judgement and counselling skills are developed in GRC 301 / 501.
levels: Levels: None · Awareness (knowledge item or reading) · Practised (partial work product or scripted exercise) · Applied (mentee produces the artefact an implementer produces by following the given rules, reviewed by AI and/or human).
